findings.entity: Block A (leftmost block held by hand)
findings.description: The held block is green with '2' at 00:00.00 and blue with '2' by 00:00.50-00:00.75. It never leaves the fingers and is not swapped, so the same object changes color.

findings.invariant_violated: continuous chain of custody (object from nowhere)
findings.description: A second blue block appears beside Block A beneath the same fingers that were holding only one block. It comes from no hand, pile, container, or frame edge, and the block appears to split off Block A. Concealed palming can't explain it because the hand was visibly holding one cube.

findings.invariant_violated: continuous chain of custody (object from nowhere)
findings.description: After Block B is turned to show '3' and moved, B shows '2' again in place and a new green '3' block emerges from its right side under the fingertips. There is no visible source for the new block.

Block D is green '3' at 00:03.50 and tan/orange '2' at 00:03.75 while it stays under the same fingers. It is not rotated in a way that would show a different face, and the body color can't change by rotation.

findings.invariant_violated: continuous chain of custody / object identity
findings.description: A blue block appears next to Block D under the fingers with no source (00:04.00). After it is set down, its color shifts from saturated blue to pale grey/white (00:04.50-00:04.75).

findings.invariant_violated: continuous chain of custody / object identity
findings.description: A blue '3' block appears beside Block E with no source (00:05.00). While held it changes from blue to teal to green (00:05.25-00:05.75), and at rest it reads '5' instead of '3' (00:06.00).

findings.entity: Block G (green '3' to green '2') and Block H (blue '3')
findings.invariant_violated: continuous chain of custody / object identity
